prompts.hero: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a cinematic ultra-wide landscape campaign photograph for fictional Mars-inspired outdoor equipment brand ORBITA. A lone expedition hiker wearing a bone-white technical parka and vermilion expedition backpack stands on the far right third of a sweeping rust-red desert ridge, enormous layered Martian canyon behind, pale peach sky, dusty sunlit atmosphere. Credible premium outdoor fashion photography, tactile grain, long shadows, restrained retro space exploration art direction. Left half is empty terrain/sky for website heading overlay. No text, no logos, no UI. Wide 16:9.
prompts.parka: Use case: product-mockup. Premium e-commerce studio photograph for Mars expedition-inspired fashion brand ORBITA: one sculptural bone-white technical hooded expedition parka, black waterproof zips, small vermilion rectangular chest patch without text, articulated sleeves, functional large pockets. Front three-quarter view, invisible mannequin, entire garment floating just above warm light gray seamless ground with subtle shadow. Crisp tactile ripstop texture, art-directed soft studio light, perfectly realistic luxury outdoor garment. Single product. Square image. No text, no watermark.
